You’re hitting a Google Drive permissions/scope issue in n8n.

This needs a person because the error can come from an OAuth scope mismatch or Drive access change, and I can’t confirm which from the info here.

What I can tell: the node is failing with “The granted scopes do not give access to all of the requested spaces.” Unconfirmed: whether this is a changed credential, a Drive sharing change, or a node/account scope mismatch.

Best route: n8n community forum.

Meanwhile, please collect the exact error, the failing execution log, your n8n version, and whether this is n8n Cloud or self-hosted with OAuth2 to Google Drive.

Handoff:
Drive access fails with a scope/permission error in Google Drive nodes.
Version/setup: unconfirmed n8n version; unconfirmed Cloud vs self-hosted; uses Google Drive/Docs OAuth2.

You’re trying to turn a Google Doc download into HTML text in n8n, but Extract from File is returning nothing.

Best route: n8n support for their plan.

Version/setup: n8n Cloud; Google Drive download → Extract from File (html); no output returned.
